cupsd.description: Configuration parameters for the CUPS daemon

ListenAddress.description: IP address or hostname to bind the CUPS server to (use * for all interfaces)

ListenPort.description: Port number for CUPS HTTP(S) listener

BindLocalhostOnly.description: If true, restricts listening to localhost only (recommended for security)

AllowFrom.description: List of allowed client addresses (IP/CIDR or hostnames); empty = allow none beyond localhost

ServerName.description: Canonical hostname of the CUPS server (displayed in web interface and job banners)

SSLEnabled.description: Enable HTTPS on port 443 for web interface (requires valid SSL certificate)

RunAsUser.description: System user account under which cupsd runs (change only if security policy requires)

RunAsGroup.description: System group account for cupsd processes

LogLevel.description: Verbosity level of the main log file (debug, info, notice, warn, error, crit)

LogFile.description: Path to the main CUPS error log file

AccessLogFile.description: Path to the CUPS access log (records HTTP requests to admin/printer pages)

JobLog.description: Path to per-job log file (optional; leave empty to disable)

MaxJobs.description: Maximum number of queued jobs to retain

MaxJobTime.description: Maximum time (in seconds) a job may remain in the queue before cancellation

KeepFiles.description: If true, retain print files until job completes; if false, delete immediately after printing

BrowsingEnabled.description: Enable broadcasting of local printers to the network via mDNS and/or CUPS-SLP

BrowseProtocols.description: Protocols to use for printer discovery; allowed values: 'cups', 'mdns'

WebInterfaceEnabled.description: Enable remote web interface (accessible over network); set to false for local-only admin

DefaultAuthType.description: Default authentication method for administrative operations

Policies.description: Print job policies (e.g., job creation, cancellation, administration)

name.description: Policy name (must match existing policy names like 'default', 'admin', 'system')

AuthInfoRequired.description: Whether user authentication is required for operations

DefaultPrinterName.description: Name of the default printer (must exist in printer database)

PrintcapFile.description: Location of the legacy BSD printcap file

SharePrinters.description: Allow sharing of locally connected printers via CUPS

RemoteAdminEnabled.description: Enable remote administration via web interface (⚠️ disable in untrusted environments)
